header: What a standard household connection is
lead: Anything larger, anything on a farm and anything with its own transformer is planned individually — these are the figures that cover roughly nine connections in ten.
caption: Single-phase and three-phase household connections, conditions valid from 1 January 2027
note: Prices are net of VAT. The connection fee is the standard fee; ground conditions, road crossings and reinstatement are charged separately at cost. Published 1 December 2026.

rows.title: Connection rating
rows.text: Above 30 kVA the connection is designed individually and quoted separately.

rows.title: Main fuse
rows.text: 63 A on request where an electric vehicle and a heat pump share the connection.

rows.title: Service cable
rows.text: Aluminium, laid at a depth of 70 cm.

rows.title: Metering
rows.text: Fifteen-minute register, read remotely once a day.

rows.title: Metering point
rows.text: In the outside wall, accessible without entering the building.

rows.title: Connection fee
rows.text: For a cable run of up to 25 m from the street boundary.

rows.title: Lead time
rows.text: From the signed contract to the meter being fitted, outside the winter break.
